snippet.title: 1000 Seconds //  Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/2948020/1000_Seconds/

1000 Seconds is a roguelike – Defeat enemies, gather resources, and upgrade your orb to escape the temporal limbo, but you only have 1000 seconds to reach the end, so be as fast as possible.

Developed by
Sunfish
